spans.text: ...End of Operation.
Hmph...
Well?! My Dolls managed to hurt you!
So...what?
This kind of scratch can be repaired by absorbing a few wraiths.
Are you really trying to clear the game with such clumsy technique? You're too slow.
As per our plan, we're retreating to 【Hot Tunes】 for now to catch a break!
My, my, what's the hurry?
We still have a welcome party. At least stay for a bit!
What?
My apologies to everyone here, it took a while to prepare this off-stage...
Now, allow me to introduce my new friend!
...El Fail clears her throat.
Please welcome—
Miss Fallen Angel!
Good evening, everyone!
Sorry, I was busy preparing my costume for my first performance. Now—
Who's ready to party all night?!
...Very orderly applause and cheers erupt from the audience.
Miss Fallen Angel came from the outside world!
After she fell from her corrupt reality into our city, I removed the blight in her heart...
She'll have nothing more to do with the worst thing about independent souls, the idiots living under massive social constructs...the contrived order built on selfish wants! What about you?!
NO!
That's right. That's exactly right!
No, it isn't!
950, wake up! I'm right here!
Sorry, but I'm the only one she hears now.
You? What can YOU do?
We'll beat you and save everyone in the city, including her!
Humph, feel free to try!
But now, let's hear our new friend sing!
I've been waiting for a long time...
To finally share my music and my new life with everyone!
That's right! I'm the only one who can make you happy!
Here, I made this especially for you. Take it and eat it!
Your music, your soul! Accept it, All in One!
...M950A starts singing.
Is this...what 950 has always dreamed of?
This is the happiness that she seeks, a side of her that you never knew.
What she wants is to run away from your constant scrutiny and reliance, to sink and rust away.
See, you don't actually understand her, do you? You don't even care about her! Who else can save her?
Me. I'm the only one who can give her music that fits her like a glove.
Only I can convey her wishes so clearly and truly satisfy her!
This isn't her music at all! You're merely imposing your own idea onto her!
950, wake up! This isn't what you want! Snap out of it!
Are you sure? Then why won't she wake up?
That's because you took away her memories of us! She's not even herself anymore!
Gee, no one can actually remember everything, right? What's wrong with forgetting random bits and pieces?
Look at her smile, and remember how she used to look so pained and irritable all the time. Anyone can tell which suits her better.
She will never abandon her responsibilities!
Responsibilities? The ones who pushed her to make this choice...are none other than you, who kept secrets from her and never tell her what you truly think!
Why bring up responsibilities now? Isn't it the best if we all leave everything behind and just have fun?
So...when are you going to join us?
If...if we can get just a little closer...
Miss Windtalker, leave it to me!
Huh?
...The Fairy with rabbit ears shouts at the top of her wispy voice.
Just because something is forgotten doesn't mean it never existed...
I finally understand that!
...Meanwhile, in the Graveyard.
...Why...are you here?
Do you hear that singing?
What about it? It's too late.
950...is gone.
But her hopes and dreams are still in her heart. She WILL return to you.
...Thunder gets to her feet and walks away.
But MY hopes and dreams...are not.
Sorry, but I'm not as brave as you. I can't face her.
Let me stay here...until the world is completely consumed...
But—
...BANG!
...Thunder fires a bullet into the sky.
...Thunder listens without saying a word...until the world falls silent once more.
I'm sorry...
Right now...I'm very sad...
If I can't express it...if I can't let it out...I might—
If you can't let it out, why don't you just face it head-on?
...A Doll appears along with the rev of an engine.
AEK?!
Your presence is weak as usual, Thunder.
If it weren't for that shot, I'd have missed you.
Your costume...and the motorbike...
The Fairies prepared them for me from what they remember. Speeds things up for me.
We're about to get 950 back. Are you coming?
I don't know...if I have the right to come.
I did too many bad things. I...I abandoned her...
You relied on her too much.
You shouldn't reflect on your behavior, but on your attitude.
We shouldn't idolize others. You'll only end up disappointed if you idealize a person blindly.
Be it us or those we admire...all we can do is be ourselves.
You only made the same mistake as I did.
Where did you pick this up? A life coach?
Ha, doesn't suit me, does it?
It'd be better if K2 could give you the same lecture that she just gave me.
You? Even you got...?
...AEK-999 looks up into the sky.
I've always hoped I would meet someone really interesting, but this assignment happened to put me with you guys. I was pretty disappointed, thinking the world is nothing special.
But this time, you saved me. Your colorful souls are so much more interesting than me, who only ever thinks about running away and seeking thrills.
Thunder, 950 is also a really interesting person. We shouldn't just be relying on her. We must also acknowledge her...
Acknowledge...her...
Have you ever wondered what it is that she really needs?
If even a virtual world like this can give her what she wants, why can't we?
If you keep running away, you'll never be able to show her your appreciation.
Just as how I almost lost my chance to do that with you all.
Hop on. K2, TMP, and the Fairies are waiting for us.
...Thunder nods and climbs onto the motorbike.
Hold tight. According to the Commander, I drive a bit too fast.
Also, aren't you two coming?
We belong here.
When everything is settled and it's time for you to leave, we'll meet again.
You seem to know a great deal.
Are you the ones who brought us here to draw out El Fail in the first place?
We've forgotten our names and our past. I don't remember who woke me and who created another me.
But we still remember that the world wasn't like this before.
I hope you'll be the saviors that restore our world. Perhaps we've made the right bet.
I don't know if we can do that, but I look forward to hearing your music.
Anyway, thanks. See you next time.
...The Fairy twins remain silent as they gradually vanish into thin air.
Are we going then?
Still feeling uneasy?
I don't know what to say...to 950...
There must be something you want to say. Just say it when it's time.
Now, we're just getting started with our comeback!
...Meanwhile, at the Black Square.
Well? Have you had your share of fun, Miss Fallen Angel?
Not yet. It's hardly enough for a new star to perform only one song on her debut, don't you think?
That's true! I like how understanding you are!
Then let's sing a duet as a special celebration for our first new star in 50 years!
Let's see... Let's go with this...
...with this backing instrumental!
...Just as El Fail is about to press the play button—
Huh?
Huhhhhh?? This is the wrong track! Who hijacked our station?!
Is that...HER music?
Rabbit Ears, you little...
What do you think you're doing?!
I'm not Rabbit Ears! I finally remember...
My name is Suee!
This is my song. MY music!
That's right, Suee!
That's your name! Our good friend Suee! You've finally come to!
Sehra and Nina, it came back to me because of your performance!
【ATK】also gave me the courage, and Miss Fallen Angel's singing...
I finally remember...how ludicrous this city has become. This isn't how Pocket City and I used to be!
Ha...congratulations then.
But I'm amazed you can still perform so happily right now.
Shouldn't you be shouting at me in anger and hatred?
No, I'm not angry at all, nor do I hate you.
I'm very glad that I can finally recall my music and the person I've been waiting for!
I found my purpose! I have to live on for its sake – happily!
Sigh... And here I went to so much trouble to help you forget it...
Why do you enjoy being shackled by such things? They're forced onto you. Do you really want them?
Besides, the humans who gave them to you have forgotten all about you and your music long ago.
That's fine... It doesn't matter!
This is the path I've chosen. I walk it gladly, so I'll keep going!
Miss 950, you have your own purpose, too, so wake up!
She's found it already. Save your breath.
My...my purpose...
I've only spent very little time with you, but thank you for being here for us.
If you hadn't come, I wouldn't have wanted to fight back and reclaim everything that's mine.
As for the things you want to do, I don't believe they're achievable in this virtual world!
What...
What am I doing...?
...M950A suddenly feels dazed.
Now! Get her back!
Huh?! Wait, what are you doing?!
...Taking advantage of M950A's confusion, the idol Fairies and K2's electronic dummies dash straight at her and drag her off the stage.
Let go of me! Who are you?!
I'm not done with my performance yet!
Hey, what are you doing? Don't do dangerous things on the stage!
...El Fail tries to pull M950A back towards her.
Suddenly, she gets shoved from behind. Her grip loosens, and M950A is carried away.
Sorry, Miss Fallen Angel, you don't belong in this world.
That really grates my ears...
A traitor like you doesn't belong in this world.
Suee, watch out!
...El Fail already has Suee tight within her grasp.
Don't you understand just how meaningless your actions are?
I've already wiped the girl's memories. They'll never be restored without my consent.
Who are you?! Return me to the stage right now!
Take her away if you want, but you won't be able to wake her.
All that's forgotten might as well have never existed...
So you really shouldn't have remembered, Miss Suee.
Let her go, El Fail!
She's an innocent Fairy!
Innocent? Music...singing...names...
These are all harmful things. You will never understand.
It's alright, Miss Windtalker...
Now that I finally have the chance, I'll keep singing!
So long as my memories are still mine, I won't let my voice falter!
In that case, come back and become a part of me!
Miss Windtalker... Miss Cat Warrior...
Suee...
Please give music...back to everyone...
Noooooo!
...El Fail clenches her fist, and with a burst of light...
...Suee disappears.
Ah...
Finally, peace...
Finally...she's back inside my heart...
She's...recovering her power...
I knew it... This is what I have to do...
This world...needs no one else but me...
C'mon then! Let's continue! No matter how many encores it takes, I'll keep performing with you!
Until you all become a part of me! Until I own this entire world again!
For my friend and for the Fairies you've taken...
I'll stop you no matter how many times it takes!
Let's begin!
